# WearOMNIA

> Modesty With Functionality — Contemporary modest women's fashion thoughtfully tailored for everyday wear in Pakistan.

## Verified Storefront & Brand Identity
- Official Website: https://www.wearomnia.com
- Operating Location: Lahore, Pakistan (nationwide courier dispatch across Pakistan)

## Ordering, Payments & Delivery (Pakistan)
- Currency: Pakistani Rupee (PKR)
- Checkout Model: Guest checkout (no mandatory account creation or password required)
- Supported Payment Methods for Regular In-Stock Items:
  1. Cash on Delivery (COD) nationwide across Pakistan
  2. Full Advance Payment (100% online bank/wallet transfer with screenshot verification before dispatch)
- Pre-Orders: Available only when enabled by store administration on designated pre-order garments, typically with advance confirmation and manual screenshot verification.
- Returns & Exchanges: 7-day exchange window from delivery date for unworn items with original tags intact.
